mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of macro regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in rate decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO declines do not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in late-cycle expansions is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above its 12-month MA, or the Rank IC over 1-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) fall below 50,000 for three consecutive months, it signals a slowing labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 45% of instances where PAYEMS < 50,000 for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime characterized by strong consumer spending, a decline in real sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening retail activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high-demand regimes, RSAFS declines do not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in high-demand regimes is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a tightening monetary cycle that raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.
